about: The small creatures' Blender build (D-332; BLENDER_PLAN row 20; tools/blender/life.mjs small, tools/blender/life_small.py). One model per kind of src/world/smallLife.ts SMALL, at the game's own length L (m; tests/life_models.test.ts checks it). Each body is the species' anatomy as blended ellipsoids (metaballs) and sheets (the insects' wings), from field-guide proportions by eye (C): the builder functions in life_small.py hold the parts. tris = [lod0, lod1] (lod1 drawn beyond lod1_per_len x L, and never nearer than lod1_min m); tex = map size; the butterfly's albedo holds its three species side by side (whites, clouded yellow, painted lady: the game picks one per instance).
